audit_title: QuantEngine Phase 195 Exact-Payload Order Write Authorization

GATE-195-A.name: Exact-payload token binding
GATE-195-A.details: Live/testnet tokens carry a canonical JSON payload SHA-256. Adapter and raw signed-REST boundaries verify the exact payload before transport I/O. Testnet minting checks product/size and preserves reserved order constraints.

GATE-195-B.name: Single-use write token
GATE-195-B.details: The raw signed-REST boundary atomically consumes each non-offline token; replay is rejected before a second transport write.

GATE-195-C.name: Focused regression
GATE-195-C.details: Phase 189-194 authorization, lifecycle, ledger, concurrency and safety suite passed. Expanded Delta execution/signing/experiment suite also passed 146 tests plus 6 subtests.

GATE-195-D0.name: Full test collection
GATE-195-D0.details: 4,875 tests collected in 5.62 seconds. Collection does not imply test execution or success.

GATE-195-D.name: Full repository suite
GATE-195-D.details: Full pytest attempt was terminated by the 180-second execution timeout at approximately 5% progress.

GATE-195-E.name: Pinned dependency environment
GATE-195-E.details: Runtime is Python 3.13.5 / pytest 9.0.2 and lacks pyarrow; documented contract is Python 3.12, pytest 9.0.3 and pyarrow==23.0.1.

GATE-195-F.name: Operator authorization provisioning
GATE-195-F.details: No genuine operator public key or signed authorization was provisioned. Synthetic keys are test-only.

GATE-195-G.name: Testnet order writes
GATE-195-G.details: No exchange network calls or order writes were performed.

GATE-195-H.name: Production clearance
GATE-195-H.details: Strategy edge is not established, full suite is incomplete, dependency contract is uncertified, and historical credential remediation remains unverified.

statement: Phase 195 improves the order-write authorization boundary. It does not authorize testnet or production execution and does not establish strategy edge.
